definitions: The act of firing a gun or other weapon.
A single attempt to score in a game such as football or basketball.
An injection of a drug or vaccine.
A small amount of an alcoholic drink.
A person skilled with a gun.
A heavy metal ball thrown in an athletic contest (shot put).
examples: He heard a shot in the distance.
It was a great shot at goal.
She took a beautiful shot of the sunset.
The doctor gave him a flu shot.
Let's have a shot of whisky.
She threw the shot over 15 metres.
